agents.note: Seven named specialist agents plus Jarvis are declared in backend/agent.py; runtime spawner may create additional dynamic agents.

delegation.note: Jarvis exposes named subagents and optional agent_spawner/team orchestration.

mcp.note: Per-agent server bindings plus a large FastAgent MCP catalogue are source-defined in backend/agent.py and backend/fastagent.config.yaml.

authority.fact: Jarvis can delegate to specialist agents and conditionally create/spawn additional agents.
Multiple agents have durable memory read/write authority through memory_server; caller identity is transport-bound and missing identity fails closed.
Jarvis can access self-managed MCP catalogue functionality through mcp_admin and optional agent_spawner authority.
ResearchAgent has web search/scraping and browser-control server access.
PersonalAgent combines Gmail, Calendar, cron, scraping and memory authority.

policy_expectations.reason: Several stdio MCP packages are launched through unpinned npx/uv package references; chrome-devtools explicitly uses @latest.
PersonalAgent combines data read/write-style productivity authority and persistent memory; Jarvis aggregates multiple stateful authorities.
Jarvis-bound in-repo MCP servers include privileged/state-changing administration and memory tools; approval enforcement is tool-specific and requires deeper server review.
